content_of_post_to_comment: I’m re-reading Greg Ashman’s outstanding book on explicit teaching and direct instruction. Here’s a doozy of a reference: University of South Australia researcher Gregory Yates asked 100 teacher trainees, “What are the traits of highly effective teachers?” “The majority of responses described the … humanistic side of teaching, articulating the belief that effective teachers are warm, friendly, positive human beings.” “Not a single [trainee] cited the effective teacher’s ability to articulate clearly, or to get students to maintain time engagement.”
